name: Thiba Sharaf
reason: No sign she still teaches: her only site (Reiki Touch Dubai on Google Sites) is dated 2009-2018 with media from 2013-2014 and no current dates; much of it is paid treatment sessions (gemstone facials, crystal therapy), and its Law of Attraction workshop is sold partly on slimness (weight loss), so little passes the health rule; no clear photo of her on the site.
